profile.name: Robo HAT MM1 电机控制板
profile.description: 用于机器人与无人小车实验的车载控制板。该组件通过串口读取来自 SAMD51 的 RC/PWM 控制信号，并将其映射为归一化的转向与油门输出，适合 DonkeyCar 类平台的人为遥控与自动驾驶控制流程。
profile.description_en: An onboard control board for robotics and autonomous RC car experiments. It reads RC/PWM control signals from a SAMD51 over serial and maps them to normalized steering and throttle outputs, suitable for DonkeyCar-like user-control and autonomous driving workflows.
